# SurfaceGuard 0.5.2

SurfaceGuard 0.5.2 is a packaging-integrity patch. The GitHub release archive now
includes the policy reference, threat model, and roadmap linked from its README, so all
relative documentation links work in an installed package without repository access.

The clean-install release gate now checks every relative README target in the packed and
installed artifact to prevent this defect from recurring.

Scanner behavior and policy semantics are unchanged from 0.5.1.

The attached package is for direct GitHub installation. This release is not published to
npm or another package registry.
